# Lisbon, April

Flight lands at 09:40, metro red line to Alameda. Stay in Alfama near the cathedral. Day 2: tram 28, then pasteis de nata
at Manteigaria. Day 3: day trip to Sintra, buy the train ticket the evening before. Book the Time Out Market dinner for
Friday. Bring a rain jacket and shoes that cope with wet cobblestones.
